topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe my essay is out there for everyone to see. It's strange, like having a part of yourself uncovered. When I wrote it, it felt so personal, like I was sharing a piece of my soul. Now, it's just there,公开地, for anyone to read. I hope it doesn't come off as too self-centered or naive. Maybe I should have been more careful or thought more about the consequences. I wonder if anyone I know will see it. I should probably tell the admissions office I want to make changes, but what if that makes things worse? It's all so overwhelming.
